title: OpenAEVC protocol 0.1.0
description: JSON representation of OpenAEVC protocol types. Canonical CBOR uses the same data model (spec/canonical-encoding.md).

AppliedEffect.description: An effect accepted into a candidate.

heads.description: Members that are lineage heads (not superseded by another member), sorted.

graph_digest.description: Digest of the canonical `{members, edges}` graph.

Baseline.description: Immutable commitment to a validated composition graph of promoted packs.

Blob.description: Opaque bytes (evidence payloads, large observation payloads).

Candidate.description: Frozen candidate state of a sealed pack generation.

candidate_effects.description: Effects accepted into the candidate so far (bound to `generation`).

ChangePack.description:
Mutable pre-promotion work under a stable identity. Every structural change produces a new
generation; historical generations stay auditable.

oneOf.description: Create a Namespace with its root principals (runtime administrators only).
Store an immutable PolicyDocument; `mandatory` adds it to the Namespace gates.
Load, handshake and register an extension from a configured extension directory.
Structural update; absent fields are unchanged. Produces a new generation.
Renew the lease. With a resumable provider, also the recovery proof for an expired lease.
Import canonical object bytes by digest (object exchange).

act_as.description: ACTOR principal linked to `caller` on whose behalf the request is made.

CommandEnvelope.description:
Signed request envelope. The signature covers the canonical encoding of the envelope with
`signature` omitted, in the `request` signature domain.

CommandReceipt.description: What a command returns: the result plus the digest of its signed receipt object.

CommandResult.description: Result data of a successful command (also embedded in its receipt).

required_actions.description: Authority actions the actor must hold on the target resource to propose this effect.

EffectProposal.description: A structured proposed change submitted by a worker through its harness.

command.description: Executable path relative to the extension directory it was registered from.

subjects.description: Typed IDs / digests this event concerns (subscription filtering).

Event.description:
Journal event (spec/events.md). `hash = SHA-256(canonical(event without hash) ||
previous_hash bytes)`.

after.description: Deliver events with sequence strictly greater than this cursor.

subjects.description: Match events whose subjects include this ID/digest (object, execution or pack).

EventFilter.description: Subscription filter. Delivery is at-least-once; consumers deduplicate by sequence.

payload.description: Digest of the Blob object holding the payload.

Evidence.description: Immutable, content-addressed evidence bound to one candidate/generation.

oneOf.description: At least one candidate-bound evidence object of `kind` exists.

Expr.description: Policy expression. JSON form is a single-key object naming the operator.

ExtensionErrorInfo.description: Error reported by an extension, nested inside `EXTENSION_FAILED`/`EXTENSION_INCOMPATIBLE`.

ExtensionRef.description: Registered extension identity bound into provenance and promoted objects.

FactValue.description: Normalized fact value consumed by policy (spec/policy.md). Untagged in JSON.

GrantBody.description: Unsigned body of a capability grant (spec/capabilities.md).

HostCapability.description:
Privileged operations an extension may request through structured host calls.
Declarations in a manifest are requests; the runtime grants per invocation.

mandatory_policies.description: Mandatory promotion policies; every qualification evaluates all of them.

NewPrincipal.description: New principal description used by `CreateNamespace` and `RegisterPrincipal`.

NodeRef.description: Active Change Graph node: typed identifier or object digest.

created_seq.description: Namespace event sequence of the event that created the object.

PolicyDecision.description: Canonical result of evaluating policies over facts for one candidate.

rules.description: All rules must hold for the document to allow.

Principal.description:
A registered principal. KEY/RUNTIME/SERVICE principals authenticate with their key; an
ACTOR has no key and is acted as by the key principal it is linked to.

provenance_root.description: Digest of the canonical list of the candidate effects' provenance records.

PromotedPack.description: Immutable accepted snapshot of a promoted ChangePack or RevisionPack.

cycle.description: For `DEPENDENCY_CYCLE`: the minimal cycle, first node repeated at the end.

Provenance.description: Minimum provenance of an execution-affecting artifact (spec/observations.md).

principal.description: Principal that speaks for the provider (heartbeats, recovery proofs).

act_as.description: ACTOR principal linked to `caller` on whose behalf the request is made.

QueryEnvelope.description:
Signed request envelope. The signature covers the canonical encoding of the envelope with
`signature` omitted, in the `request` signature domain.

Receipt.description: Canonical command receipt, signed by the runtime key.

extension.description: Extension responsible for interpreting this resource kind.

ResourceRef.description:
Address of a domain resource. The locator is opaque to the runtime and interpreted by the
owning extension. Resources are always scoped to the Namespace of the object holding them.

ResourceSelector.description:
Selects resources a grant applies to. `kind` is an exact kind, `*`, or a `prefix.*`
pattern; `locator_prefix` further restricts locators.

targets.description: Digests of the target PromotedPack objects.

RunProvenance.description: Who ran a verification/evaluation and in which request.

SignatureEntry.description: One signature over an object or envelope, with the key that produced it.

SignedGrant.description: A grant plus the issuer's Ed25519 signature over `canonical(body)` in the `grant` domain.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp; canonical output has nine fraction digits.

TransitionInfo.description: A lifecycle transition that was refused.

WorkUnit.description: Generic unit of work. Products may present it as a task, job, action or assignment.
